en: Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a riverside townscape. On the left stands a prominent church with a tall spire above clustered wooden and masonry buildings on a slope. The river runs across the foreground with timber or bridge-pier structures in the water. On the right bank are more houses and a large multi-storey building among trees. Printed captions appear in Latvian along the bottom border.
